metadata.description: Primary references for documentation coverage, freshness, contract validation, AI instruction audits, and CI quality gates.
metadata.title: QA Docs Coverage - Sources

contracts_and_schemas.name: OpenAPI Specification
contracts_and_schemas.description: Primary reference for REST API contracts.

contracts_and_schemas.name: AsyncAPI Specification v3.1
contracts_and_schemas.description: Primary reference for event-driven API contracts, currently on the 3.x line (3.0 released Nov 2023, 3.1.0 also published). New documents should default to `asyncapi: 3.0.0` unless a 3.1-only feature is needed.

contracts_and_schemas.name: JSON Schema
contracts_and_schemas.description: Schema standard for payload validation and documentation.

documentation_frameworks.name: Diataxis
documentation_frameworks.description: Information architecture for tutorials, how-to guides, reference, and explanation. Created 2020 by Daniele Procida (Django core developer, Director of Engineering for documentation at Canonical); see the colophon at https://diataxis.fr/colophon/ for attribution and history.

documentation_frameworks.name: Write the Docs Guide
documentation_frameworks.description: Community guidance for docs workflows and governance.

quality_gates.name: Vale
quality_gates.description: Prose linting for docs quality checks. Actively maintained with LSP support (vale-ls) and Views for targeted YAML/JSON/TOML scoping; check the GitHub releases page (https://github.com/vale-cli/vale/releases) for the exact current version before pinning one in CI, since the project moved from errata-ai/vale to vale-cli/vale and version numbers found in older docs may lag.

quality_gates.name: markdownlint-cli2
quality_gates.description: Fast, configuration-based Markdown linting CLI. v0.23.0+ as of July 2026 (npm). Prefer markdownlint-cli2 over the legacy markdownlint-cli.

quality_gates.name: Lychee
quality_gates.description: Fast external link checking for CI and large docs trees. v0.24.x releases current as of mid-2026; confirm the pinned version in lycheeverse/lychee-action before relying on a specific number.

api_validation.name: Spectral
api_validation.description: Linter for OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, and Arazzo v1 documents.

api_validation.name: Redocly CLI Lint
api_validation.description: OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, and Arazzo linting, bundling, and preview. v2.36.0+ as of June 2026 (ESM-only from v2, requires Node.js 22.12+ or 20.19+).

api_validation.name: AsyncAPI CLI
api_validation.description: Validation and tooling for AsyncAPI specs.

api_validation.name: oasdiff
api_validation.description: Breaking-change detection for OpenAPI diffs. 300+ rules, GitHub Action available. Primary replacement for Optic, whose GitHub repo was archived 2026-01-12 following Atlassian's April 2024 acquisition and no subsequent Compass integration shipping.

docstring_and_code_doc_coverage.name: interrogate
docstring_and_code_doc_coverage.description: Python docstring coverage checker; reports which modules, classes, functions, and methods lack docstrings and can gate CI on a minimum coverage percentage. Coverage percentage measures presence only, not quality — pair with a manual spot-check (see SKILL.md Coverage vs. Usefulness).

docstring_and_code_doc_coverage.name: docstr-coverage
docstring_and_code_doc_coverage.description: Python docstring coverage tool with per-file and project-wide statistics; predates and partly inspired interrogate. Same presence-not-quality caveat applies.

ai_instruction_coverage.name: OpenAI AGENTS.md Guide
ai_instruction_coverage.description: Current AGENTS.md behavior for Codex and OpenAI coding agents. Discovery walks git root to cwd, concatenating global ~/.codex/AGENTS.md plus every AGENTS.md on the path; 32 KiB combined cap by default (project_doc_max_bytes in ~/.codex/config.toml); files discovered later can be partially or fully dropped once the cap is hit.

ai_instruction_coverage.name: Anthropic Claude Memory
ai_instruction_coverage.description: Current CLAUDE.md and imported memory guidance. As of 2026 this covers two complementary systems: CLAUDE.md (instructions the user writes) and Auto memory (notes Claude writes itself from corrections and observed preferences) — an AI-instruction audit should check both, not just CLAUDE.md.

ai_instruction_coverage.name: Anthropic Claude Best Practices
ai_instruction_coverage.description: Current Claude Code workflow and repo guidance.

ai_instruction_coverage.name: Model Context Protocol Intro
ai_instruction_coverage.description: Overview of MCP resources, tools, and prompts for agent-connected systems.

ai_instruction_coverage.name: llms.txt specification
ai_instruction_coverage.description: De facto convention for AI-agent-readable docs. Plain Markdown at /llms.txt summarizes API endpoints, auth, and schemas for IDE agents, MCP tools, and coding assistants. Adopted by Stripe, Cloudflare, and Vercel among others; not an RFC or W3C standard. Adoption-rate and citation-impact claims vary widely by methodology (one crawl reports 844,000+ sites via BuiltWith while independent Tranco-Top-10k crawls in 2026 find roughly 5-10% adoption, and at least one 2026 analysis found no measurable correlation between having llms.txt and being cited by LLMs) — treat any single adoption number as unverified as of 2026-07-11 and cite the methodology, not just the figure.

large_repo_context.name: gitingest
large_repo_context.description: Prompt-friendly repository ingest for large repos.

large_repo_context.name: repo-to-text
large_repo_context.description: Selective repository-to-text extraction for large codebase audits.

optional_ai_doc_tools.name: Mintlify
optional_ai_doc_tools.description: Commercial docs platform; optional for teams with managed docs portals.

optional_ai_doc_tools.name: Documentation.AI
optional_ai_doc_tools.description: Optional AI documentation tooling; verify claims before recommending.

optional_ai_doc_tools.name: Fern API docs
optional_ai_doc_tools.description: API docs generation with automatic llms.txt output and OpenAPI-driven reference pages. Optional for teams adopting agent-readable docs.

governance.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
governance.description: Optional governance baseline for AI-assisted documentation workflows.
